name: eino-strict-option-consumption-validation
instr:
Eino cannot detect options silently ignored by parser, graph, and agent operations. Add opt-in strict option-consumption validation. When omitted, it must not change results, precedence, metadata, callbacks, streams, or events.

Report all unconsumed options together in input order, with zero-based positions and subsystem-specific targets, without exposing closure internals. Diagnostics must be invocation-local and deterministic when values are reused sequentially or concurrently.

Parser validation follows URI-based ExtParser selection, including fallbacks. TextParser consumes common URI and metadata options but rejects unused implementation-specific options. A fallback receiving repeated strict option slices reports every unresolved original position on every call.

Strict graph calls accept matching nested NodePath designations and reject unmatched ones before node execution. Invoke, Stream, Collect, and Transform behave identically while preserving successful output and stream ownership.

Agent validation follows designation and nested filtering. Removed callbacks and cancellation options count as consumed. Nested workflows and later resumes distinguish intentionally filtered options from unmatched agent designations without starting invalid work.
